scientific_integrity: Direct proof, exact-symbolic finite verification, named public sources, self-review only. Novelty priority not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic unadjusted coordinate Euler sampling, iid positive coordinate probabilities, centered SPD quadratic target. Only finite-step Gaussian invariant existence and classification are claimed; non-Gaussian existence is established under strict coordinatewise stability. Does not cover nonquadratic, underdamped, Metropolized, or finite-precision dynamics.
title: Exact Gaussian-invariance classification for random-coordinate Langevin Euler sampling
